title: Site reads answer compact by default — page list in the working language as rows, describe without blockKinds, one shared field next, WordPress bodies over 4,000 characters as outlines, extension.list 20 rows with search — and full:true answers as before
steps: S1: No stand, no browser, no model. Work in the TCH checkout at the commit under test, with its dependencies installed (pnpm install) and the deepseek-harness submodule initialised.
S2: From the checkout root run: node --test packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/read-compact.test.mjs — keep its last 12 lines and its exit code.

S3: Run: node --test packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/describe-compact.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/site-call.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/content-read-grammar.test.mjs — keep its last 12 lines and its exit code.

S4: Run: grep -c 'blockKindsOmitted' packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/lib/index.js; grep -c 'var BODY_SHOWN_MAX = 4e3' packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/lib/index.js; grep -c 'function takeViewParams' packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/lib/index.js — keep the three numbers.
S5: Read the 'ℹ pass' and 'ℹ fail' lines of S2 and S3. A command that cannot start (missing module) is BLOCKED, not FAIL.
expect: S2: pass 14, fail 0. Through runSiteCall with neutral relay-shaped fixtures: a Joomla page list in three languages shows only the working language (facts.siteLanguage when defaultLocale is null) and the every-language pages as [title, path, id, record] rows, counts the others in otherLanguages, and is under 20% of the relayed size; a describe has no blockKinds (blockKindsOmitted names blockKinds:true) and keeps where whole; a page read has no per-field next, a fieldNext template that gives every field's next back, constraints of maxCharacters only, no blocks without fields, and is under 55% of the relayed size; a WordPress body of 6k is an outline; extension.list shows 20 of 240 unique rows with byType and reads search/type/offset/limit itself; with full:true every one of these is the answer as before, and full, blockKinds, search, type, offset and limit are never relayed. Before the fix: 13 of the 14 fail.
S3: fail 0: the describe's lossless compaction, the WordPress body-by-blocks rules and the content.read grammar still hold.
S4: 1, 1, 1: the committed lib/index.js carries the change (RULE #3: the image copies lib/ as it is).

selectors.wiring: packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/src/host/site-call.mjs runSiteCall — takeViewParams before normalizeCall; compactPageList before contentReadNext; narrowDescribe/compactContents/pageListRows after compactDescribe; BODY_SHOWN_MAX

evidence: Flow D of the Apply audit, 05/10/2026 (55 runs on benchwpapply02, benchemdashapply01, benchjoomlaapply01): site-read answers were 15.6% of all prompt tokens. Recorded answers re-run through the new code: Joomla page list 23,455 -> ~2,500 characters, Joomla page read 27,584 -> 14,802, WordPress describe 23,776 -> 11,026, EmDash describe 19,488 -> 3,218, extension.list 49,932 -> 3,024; all site reads 556k -> 192k characters (-65%).
fence: Mechanism only: what the model is shown of a site read, and that full:true and the replace job's reads are unchanged. Not covered: whether a model then needs one more call to reach what was left out (a bench measure, flaky by nature).
